conditions.no-public-serving: Install controllers/CRDs only. No Gateway, InferencePool, HTTPRoute, AIGatewayRoute or model is installed; this review does not authorize public or tenant traffic.
conditions.private-peers: Cilium restricts ingress to the cluster API, fixed controller namespaces and Prometheus; no controller Service is public. CPU/memory are bounded; administrative Kubernetes writes require authenticated RBAC.
conditions.no-jwks: No JWT/OIDC/OAuth/JWKS policies or untrusted JWK input are configured. Subsequent authentication policy changes require another review.
conditions.private-ca: Controller TLS clients use the private cluster/API roots and fixed cluster peers; arbitrary public issuer/backends and tenant-controlled certificates are not enabled.
conditions.inference-pool-reader: Envoy watches only llm-d, inference-gateway and its automatically included own namespace. Its extra InferencePool permission is get/list/watch in exactly those three namespaces, without mutation or secret access.
